card.name: Describing educational games and puzzles
card.fires_on: Words inside descriptions of online games or puzzles that explain the player's task, such as help, without, maneuver, find, keep. Mostly from kids' educational game pages.

modes.label: Goal of the game
modes.description: Verbs and linking words in a sentence saying what the player must do in a game.

modes.description: Short words in a call to the player or student to solve something.
modes.example: Puppy in the Window Find<< the>> missing digit in a division calculation.
